controlifychords.binding.open_config.des: Bind any controller button to this in Controlify; pressing it opens the chord config.
controlifychords.config.title: Controlify Chords
controlifychords.config.key_pool.tip: Add every button you want to use in chords, e.g. controlify:button/dpad_up. Chords may only use buttons in this pool; empty pool means no restriction.
controlifychords.config.debug.tip: Log chord state changes and skip reasons.
controlifychords.config.help: A chord = modifier list + trigger list. Hold all modifiers; if the same key set is configured in multiple orders (LB+RB and RB+LB), they are distinguished automatically. Tapping any trigger runs the action. Releasing any modifier cancels; the action runs when the trigger is released.
controlifychords.config.chord.new.tip: Fill this page and save to append a new chord. Leave it empty to add nothing. No limit on the number of chords.
controlifychords.config.name: Display name
controlifychords.config.modifiers.tip: Keys you keep held, e.g. controlify:button/dpad_up, controlify:button/left_shoulder.
controlifychords.config.triggers.tip: Keys you tap once, e.g. controlify:button/south, controlify:button/north. Must be released within 8 ticks.
controlifychords.config.action_value.tip: KEY_MAPPING: a key name such as key.swapOffhand. COMMAND: e.g. /spawn. CUSTOM: a registered action id.
controlifychords.config.delete.tip: Enable and save to delete this chord.
